step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents CloudHealth by VMware's real-time cloud security event processing pipeline. Data flows into a collection Kinesis Data Stream, which writes resource configuration states to Amazon Neptune (a graph database). Neptune replicates and outputs data into Elasticsearch and DynamoDB for search and analytics. CloudWatch gathers metrics from Neptune and Elasticsearch, which are consumed by a Shard Service that feeds capacity decisions back into the collection layer. A secondary Kinesis Data Stream handles rule execution, evaluating rules against Neptune graph state, storing violation findings in DynamoDB, and sending real-time notifications via Slack and email.
